output_list.criticism: The _transfer function in the INTToken contract does not check for integer overflow when adding or subtracting balances. This could allow an attacker to transfer an amount of tokens greater than the total supply, leading to a loss of funds for the contract owner.

The INTToken contract has an owner variable that can be modified by anyone. This could allow an attacker to transfer ownership of the contract and take control of the token supply. Additionally, the onlyOwner modifier is not used in the transferOwnership function, allowing anyone to transfer ownership.
